description: Phase 5: the Warmup challenge preset (easy, $30, 60 s, no objective) on Classic with three Blues. Freezes the challenge set-up (cash, difficulty, wave sizes and speeds), the time limit (up at 59.6 s on the wave manager's 200 ms check, rounded seconds), the end of the waves and the once-a-second real-time win check that passes it when the field is clear.
